subtitle: Apps picked for you

apps.name: MochiLoad
apps.subtitle: Install and refresh apps, no computer needed.
apps.localizedDescription:
MochiLoad installs apps the App Store doesn't have and keeps them working by refreshing them before they expire.

Updating here keeps your apps, your sign-in and your pairing.

versions.localizedDescription: Pairing code in the Dynamic Island and on the lock screen

apps.name: MochiChange
apps.subtitle: Change your iPhone's location from the iPhone itself.
apps.localizedDescription:
Jump anywhere, or walk, run, bike, drive, fly or sail along real routes. Real traffic lights, speed limits, saved routes, joystick and more.

Needs iOS 17.4 or later, Developer Mode and LocalDevVPN.
